claim: On February 5, 2025 AWS Step Functions increased the default quota for registered state machines and activities from 10,000 to 100,000.
question: When was the registered state machines and activities quota raised, and what was the old value?

qualifiers.scope: registered state machines and activities per account
qualifiers.condition: The new quota is applied automatically to all AWS accounts.

evidence.quote: AWS Step Functions has increased the default quota for the maximum number of registered state machines and activities from 10,000 to 100,000.

note: d014. Posted Feb 5, 2025. Current-truth facts: step-functions-quota-registered-state-machines (changed set, old value 10,000), step-functions-quota-registered-activities. Older exam questions may assume 10,000.
